name: The Name of the Beast
objectiveText: Speak with Lord Arkkoroc in Azshara . Begin your search at the waters edge to find the Temple of Arkkoran.

comments.body:
[b]77,42[/b] is Lord Arkkoroc.  He sends you to the next quest:

https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=3201/at-last

Those without coord capabilities, it is the island to the north of the great horseshoe shaped coast.  It is crawling with level 53 and 54 crab fellows and murloc types.  You enter a big temple.  The bridge to the temple runs from the shore to the temple and you can see it on your map.  It is named the Temple of Arkkoran.  It is like the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus ... he is upstairs.  The place is crawling with mobs, but as a 59 rogue I just stealthed to him and picked pockets on the way.  The crab fellows and murlocs are all humanoid.  He is a friendly (to Alliance) Level 60 Giant (elite).  He looks like the giants wandering the shallows of this zone.

Be high enough so that the mob levels are green to you. Inside the temple their a lot of Lord Arkkoroc's minions and you'll aggro a lot of them. It will take you a while to swim to his temple, fight through a lot of mobs and talk to him.

He's also friendly to Horde...which is more than I can say for the murlocs and pincers that surround the place.  Go into the building and up the ramp and you'll find him.  As a 57 my aggro range wasn't too bad so I was able to sneak up the outside wall without too many fights.
The makuras call for help when low health. so be careful of adds. cakewalk at 59 tho
I fought about 5-8 mobs in total to get to him (depends where you start counting). Not elites, not a big deal, at least not for my warrior :)
If your in a hurry, or don't feel like killing all the mobs just die at the entrance to the temple.  The walk up to the second floor with your ghost and rez.

77,42 is Lord Arkkoroc 

good luck guys ;)
